groups.place: HEART OF DEIMOS, THEN THE WAR WITHIN

rows.label: Heart of Deimos
rows.note: opens Cambion Drift, the Necralisk and the Entrati

rows.label: The War Within
rows.note: Transference, needed for vault doors and the Necraloid room

rows.label: one free Archwing weapon slot
rows.note: Bonewidow also hands over a Mausolon

conditions: Ironbride has no blueprint or drop; it is Bonewidow's Exalted Ironbride ability weapon and arrives with the Necramech.

groups.activity: kill the vault Necramechs for Orokin Matrices and damaged parts
groups.mode: Nekros with a Resource Drop Booster

rows.label: Orokin Orientation Matrix
rows.note: Rank 1 sacrifice; 1,000 standing each at Loid

rows.label: Orokin Ballistics Matrix
rows.note: Rank 2 sacrifice; 2,500 standing each

rows.label: Orokin Animus Matrix
rows.note: Rank 3 sacrifice; 5,000 standing each

conditions: Orokin Matrices traded to Loid are the only Necraloid standing source.
Each rank-up wants a different matrix tier, so every vault tier has to be cleared once; run the highest tier you have unlocked.
Three failed Requiem Cipher attempts lock that vault for the run and forfeit its bonus reward.
Vault reward tables rotate A/B/C with the Fass/Vome cycle.
bonuses: Leaving early through the Esophage keeps the rewards earned so far.
Groups farming Sporothrix or Arum Spinosa chain vaults constantly; joining one piles up matrices and damaged parts.

groups.activity: rank Necraloid to Clearance: Odima, then buy the blueprints

rows.label: Clearance: Agnesis
rows.note: 5,000 standing, 10 Orientation Matrix, 150 Void Traces, Zymos Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

rows.label: Clearance: Modus
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 15 Ballistics Matrix, 250 Void Traces, Sepulcrum Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

rows.label: Clearance: Odima
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 15 Animus Matrix, 350 Void Traces, Trumna Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

rows.label: Bonewidow component blueprints
rows.note: Casing, Engine, Capsule, Weapon Pod; 3,500 standing each at Rank 2

rows.label: Bonewidow Blueprint
rows.note: 10,000 standing at Rank 3

conditions: The matrix sacrifices stall people, not the standing. Bank each tier's matrices before the rank-up.
The barrel blueprints sacrificed come from Loid's own wares; buy them and set them aside before you hit the daily cap.

rows.label: Devolved Namalon Blueprint
rows.note: 2,000 standing, Rank 1

rows.label: Adramal Alloy Blueprint
rows.note: 1,000 standing

rows.label: Thaumic Distillate Blueprint
rows.note: 4,000 standing, Rank 2

rows.label: Tempered Bapholite Blueprint
rows.note: 1,000 standing, Neutral

conditions: Cranial Foremount comes from filleting Myxostomata, whose Processed Vome Residue bait is sold at Entrati Rank 4; Requiem Obelisks are the way around that gate.

groups.activity: mine, fish, and run Requiem Obelisks
groups.meta: refine at Otak, 20 per craft, 1,000 cr each
groups.mode: Ivara with the silent drill for Namalon

rows.label: Cranial Foremount
rows.note: fillet Myxostomata at Daughter

conditions: Update 29.5 cut the Namalon mining rate in favour of Thaumica; Namalon is the resource this Necramech is known for.
Namalon veins sit on vegetation and don't move with the Vome/Fass cycle.
bonuses: Requiem Obelisks drop a spread of Drift minerals, rares included, and bonus-vault storage containers can drop Namalon.
Trading any Drift gems and ores to Otak earns Otak Tokens, which buy Namalon when the veins go cold.

groups.activity: build the four components, then Bonewidow

rows.label: Casing
rows.note: Damaged Casing, 100 Tempered Bapholite, 20 Thaumic Distillate, 15 Goblite Tears

rows.label: Engine
rows.note: Damaged Engine, 120 Adramal Alloy, 2 Cranial Foremount, 750 Titanium

rows.label: Capsule
rows.note: Damaged Pod, 4 Scintillant, 20 Biotic Filter, 6 Star Crimzian

rows.label: Weapon Pod
rows.note: Damaged Weapon Pod, 6 Spinal Core Section, 80 Devolved Namalon, 45 Scrap

rows.label: Bonewidow
rows.note: claim it and Ironbride is her 4th ability

conditions: Ironbride gives no Mastery; Bonewidow's own levels are what count.
Component and main blueprints can't be traded; built components can.
bonuses: Doing Voidrig first builds the Necraloid ranks and matrix stock once; Bonewidow then adds mostly mining.

disclosures.title: check the recipe in game
disclosures.body: Updates 34.0 and 36.0 cut Voidrig's recipe, removing Scintillant, Cranial Foremount and Thaumic Distillate from it. This bill is the wiki's Bonewidow list; if the Foundry shows a shorter one, trust the Foundry and skip the matching farm rows.
